name: Suzhou Oriental Semiconductor Company Limited
summary: Headquartered in Suzhou, China, Suzhou Oriental Semiconductor Company Limited is a Chinese enterprise specializing in semiconductor technology, established in 2008. The company develops and supplies a diverse portfolio of products, including GreenMOS, SGTMOS, IGBTs, hybrid FETs, and Silicon Carbide (SiC) devices. These components are essential for a variety of applications, such as switched-mode power supplies (SMPS), inverters, motor drivers, and electric vehicle (EV) charging systems, among others.
